name: Phantom Of The Lily
storyline:
David Morgan is an elderly woodcutter living a solitary life in a cabin deep within the silent forests of Arizona. Having tragically lost his wife, Lily, fourteen years ago, he still bears the heavy burden of her absence on his shoulders.

Following a disturbing incident, Morgan finds himself entangled in a chain of inexplicable events. Desperate to free himself from this emotional weight, he attempts to unravel the mystery surrounding him, only to sink deeper into the abyss. As the story unfolds, he realizes that these terrors are not random; they are manifestations of a curse born from his own dark past—a curse he must break to survive.

To lift the curse, a series of rituals must be performed. Throughout the game, you will hunt for the necessary ritual artifacts. With every object found, Morgan uncovers a dark trace of his history and must struggle to silence the maddening voices in his head.

But to destroy the curse once and for all, one final sacrifice must be made...
summary: Phantom of the Lily is a psychological horror game with a dark narrative. Solve mind-bending puzzles, piece together clues in an eerie atmosphere, and reveal the truth in a terrifying world. Can you preserve your sanity and wake up from this nightmare?
